Capacity: 150 guests
Mid-season (April, October) rental €7,250 per night
Peak season (May to September) rental €8,500 per night
Rates include VAT; cleaning fee €1,750 + IVA; 40% deposit, rest 6 weeks before
52 overnight guests standard, up to 78 for an extra charge, 150 event guests
No sound restrictions
Must use one of 5 recommended exclusive caterers; food trucks cannot replace the wedding meal
2027 open dates offered in March, April and late October to early December; many more in 2028
Under 30 minutes from Barcelona airport, a few minutes by car from Sitges
Coordinator not mandatory but strongly advised for big weddings
Website check: Site: events up to 250 and 'We can seat 150 guests'; the email's cap of 150 is for seated dining (250 dancing only). Consistent; record max 150 = seated, 250 = standing/dancing.
Website check: Site lodging: '52 overnight persons as a standard, up to 78'; home page also says 'expand to 76' once. Email says 78.
Website check: Coordinates left null: OpenStreetMap has no point for the estate, only the town centre.
Wedding meal must come from one of the venue's 5 approved caterers (Art de Cook, Blue Moon, Caravan Made, Dini, Eskisit)
Approved caterers' 2027 menus: food €121 to €225 per person before 10% VAT; open bar included in most packages
All-in catering for 150 guests (menu, bar, rentals, stated fees, VAT): about €178.75 to €263.82 per person
Minimum stay is 3 nights Monday to Thursday or 4 nights Thursday to Monday, in every season
2028 open dates: 13 Mar-13 Apr, 24 Apr-11 May, 15-25 May, 1-5 Jun, 19-22 Jun, 26 Jun-2 Oct, 9 Oct-30 Nov
24 bedrooms, 20 bathrooms plus 4 guest bathrooms
32 hectares of grounds; house of 2,200 m2 with pool, jacuzzi, heated small pool, BBQ and Bodega
Best weather April to October; outdoor heaters provided for dinner in April and October; March is low season and colder
No on-site overflow; many hotels in nearby Sitges
Venue expects about 75% of invited guests to come to a destination wedding (so 200 invited -> 150)
Extra sleeping options cost €75 per night each, linens and towels included
Baby cribs €50 per stay; high chairs available
Separate professional kitchen for caterers; guest kitchen for breakfast and light meals
Courtyard furniture: 9 wooden tables (10 per table) and 78 wooden chairs, 2 fire pits
House tableware is for 78 people (plates, cutlery, glasses)
Breakfast terrace seats up to 20 at 2 long tables
Bodega is the party space and rain plan: app-controlled mood lights, disco balls, air conditioning, JBL speaker with 4 microphones
Outside lounge has a paved dance floor; JBL PartyBox 310 with 4 mics on site
Rain canopy in the outside lounge seats up to 78; needs 24 hours notice
Heated jacuzzi and jet pool seats 40; 25 sunbeds plus 30 portable; no glass around pools
10 gas heaters in the colder months; easels, lectern, wooden frame, EV charging
Laser projector with stand and screen €175 per stay
Bodega curtain drapes €175 to install and remove
Recommended planner Weddings by Sam and Grace: day-of €1,500 + IVA, full planning €3,500 + IVA (Puro Blanco retiring before 2028)
Planner La Salvaje: day-of €1,850 + IVA, full planning €3,950 + IVA
Other planners: Studio Marieta full planning from €6,995 + IVA; Vows of Joy coordination from €3,350 + IVA
Celebrants €775 (Laura Gil) and €790 (Amanda O´Shea)
Photographers about €2,000 to €3,600 for a full day
DJ Laura Cubero €995 + IVA for 3 hours with sound and lights
Live music: Spanish guitar €400 + IVA, string duo €1,300 ceremony, sax from €600, Los Stompers band €1,755-2,175
Bridal hair and make-up packages €499 to €700
Private nannies €20 per hour each
Local driver with 8-seat minibus 8 am to 11.45 pm; Sorbeti for late-night large-group shuttles
Hotel Calipolis Sitges: code 'almanita' for 5% off plus 5% club = 10%; also MIM (4-star) and ME Terramar (5-star)
Local beer company installs kegs; local wine/cava can be delivered
Food trucks listed: 600 Crepes, Una Pizza, Cal Pastor (Mexican), Parallelo Gelato; Paellas en Casa; Forns Enrich bakery delivers; grazing platters non-wedding days only
Straws n Berries grazing platters are for non-wedding days only
Private chef Chapman (non-wedding-day meals): tapas menu €43 per person, staffing and IVA extra
Chapman per-head prices: paella €26, BBQ €29-35, breakfast €20, brunch €27, tapas €37; kids 0-5 free, 5-11 half; staffing not included
Chapman prices exclude staffing
